mechanism.name: OI_CONFIRMED_CONTINUATION
mechanism.statement: Significant new position-stock expansion confirms the immediately preceding price direction and predicts continuation in the next completed hour. Primary qualifying condition is OI expansion only (robust z >= +1.0); OI contraction hours yield NO_TRADE in the discovery design.

common_window_utc.pre_common_auxiliary_data: BTCUSDT 2020-09-01..2021-11-30 OI preserved as PRE_COMMON_AUXILIARY_DATA; MUST NOT influence hypothesis selection, thresholds, metrics or performance (default frozen here)

archive_validity_vs_decision_eligibility.ARCHIVE_DAY_VALIDITY: OI_DAY_VALIDITY_LEDGER.jsonl is a forensic data-quality artifact; it does NOT directly control historical decision eligibility
archive_validity_vs_decision_eligibility.DECISION_ELIGIBILITY_AT_T: strictly causal (data_time <= T): completed 1h price bar exists; CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS = exactly 12 distinct 5m OI snapshots in the completed hour; previous-hour reference complete; rolling feature history >= minimum; last observation not stale (<= 600s); no future knowledge of the remainder of the UTC day. A gap strictly AFTER T must not alter eligibility or feature/signal state at T (adversarially tested).

price_authority.description: committed frozen 12-field official Binance USD-M 1h klines (H1 dataset; unchanged since cb3de4f; covers the entire common window through the 2026-09-10T00:00Z bucket)
price_authority.temporary_extension_files: NOT part of H6 authority and MUST NOT be referenced (data/raw/binance_um/klines_1h_ext/ was probed for the authority audit and is excluded)

decision_timeframe.oi_aggregation_rule: causal: use only 5m observations with oi_time <= decision_time; CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS requires exactly 12 distinct snapshots in the completed decision hour
decision_timeframe.pit_invariant: oi_time <= decision_time for every observation used

feature_transformations.name: delta_oi_1h
feature_transformations.definition: sum_open_interest(last 5m snapshot of completed hour H) - sum_open_interest(last 5m snapshot of completed hour H-1); base-asset units; requires exactly 12 distinct snapshots in BOTH hours, else NO_SIGNAL for that hour

feature_transformations.name: z_oi
feature_transformations.definition: ROBUST location/scale z-score of delta_oi_1h: z = (delta_oi - rolling_median) / (1.4826 * rolling_MAD) over the trailing 30 calendar days (720 completed hourly changes) strictly BEFORE the decision time; if MAD == 0 => NO_SIGNAL
feature_transformations.window: 30d trailing, center=median, scale=1.4826*MAD, min 336 valid historical observations
feature_transformations.note: single frozen robust definition; rolling std is NOT used; no alternative scale was evaluated

feature_transformations.name: price_direction_1h
feature_transformations.definition: completed decision-hour close > open => UP; close < open => DOWN; close == open => NO_SIGNAL

z_oi.update: strictly trailing, recompute per decision hour from PIT data only

threshold_rule.contraction_condition: NOT USED in discovery design: OI contraction hours produce NO_TRADE (P0-D simplification; a contraction-reversal variant would be a separate preregistered experiment)
threshold_rule.neutral_or_insufficient: z_oi < +1.0, MAD == 0, or < 336 historical observations => NO_SIGNAL
threshold_rule.note: thresholds frozen BEFORE any performance observation; NO parameter sweep is permitted; changing these values after any economic execution invalidates the experiment

direction_semantics.NO_TRADE: z_oi < +1.0, or price close == open, or any NO_SIGNAL condition
direction_semantics.no_inferred_direction: direction derives only from the frozen price/OI definitions above

entry_timing: next 1h bar OPEN (the bar immediately after the decision hour)
stop_invalidation: NONE in the primary H6 discovery test (no ATR stop, no signal-flip exit; trade management belongs to a later preregistered experiment)
cooldown: NONE required: fixed 1h non-overlapping per-asset outcome definition (entry at next hour open, exit at that hour's close); secondary horizons are NOT computed and MAY NOT influence PASS/FAIL

cost_model.definition: 10 bps is the TOTAL modeled round-trip trading friction (single canonical number; not decomposed into per-side fees/slippage)
cost_model.sensitivity_role: diagnostic robustness only, NOT parameter selection
cost_model.primary_gate_application: primary economic gates use 10 bps TOTAL RT

funding_accounting.reason: no PIT-safe authoritative funding series exists in the repository for all three assets (BTCUSDT deep series exists in docs/external-audit-01/carry-funding-deep-01/; ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT do not)
funding_accounting.note: funding is NOT silently zero forever; any promotion requires a funding materiality audit

minimum_N.note: hours are the independent unit; non-overlapping 1h outcomes per asset; if realized N is below minimum, result is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (a FAIL-class outcome, not a promotion)

robustness_gates: halves consistency: sign of net expectancy must agree across first/second half of the common window
thirds consistency: at least 2 of 3 thirds positive net expectancy
walk-forward: rolling 3-fold forward evaluation must not have all folds negative

statistical_gates.permutation: sign-flip permutation on hourly trade returns, 10,000 draws, fixed seed 20260911

orthogonality_gates.comparator: the exact preregistered ROC(24h) momentum proxy definition (frozen before H6 execution; daily series construction frozen before execution)
orthogonality_gates.H5_PNL_CORRELATION: NOT_EVALUABLE_FROM_PERSISTED_EVIDENCE (H5 daily PnL arrays were never persisted; do not regenerate H5)
orthogonality_gates.implementation: CORRECT Pearson implementation, verified by the standard self-test r(X,X)=1, r(X,-X)=-1, constant series guarded
orthogonality_gates.violation: violation => no promotion regardless of economics

pit_rules.price: decision hour uses only the completed bucket's OHLC
pit_rules.features: z-score windows strictly trailing; no centered windows; no backfill; no interpolation from future data
pit_rules.future_mutation: DECISION_ELIGIBILITY_AT_T, FEATURE_STATE_AT_T and SIGNAL_INPUT_AT_T must be byte-identical under mutations strictly after T (FUTURE_SAME_DAY_GAP_MUTATION test); PAST_GAP_BEFORE_T may change eligibility; FUTURE_GAP_AFTER_T must not
pit_rules.archive_validity_role: day-level ledger is evidence only; eligibility is causal per decision time

insufficient_sample_policy: if realized N < minimum_N, or any gate dataset is missing, result = INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE / REPAIR_REQUIRED; no parameter relaxation, no window extension to chase N

pass_fail_semantics.PASS_requires: ALL of: minimum_N met, net expectancy > 0 at 10 bps TOTAL RT, P(Sharpe>0) >= 0.90, permutation p <= 0.05, Sharpe CI excludes 0, halves + thirds + walk-forward consistent, |daily corr vs momentum proxy| <= 0.50, funding materiality gate if promoted
pass_fail_semantics.FAIL_is_terminal: any unmet gate => DISCOVERY_FAIL, terminal, recorded in FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY.md; post-hoc subcells are POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY and never promoted
pass_fail_semantics.no_rerun: no rerun, no retuning, no threshold change after first economic execution

experiment_invalidation: spec/manifest hash drift, dataset fingerprint drift, or any execution before this prereg is committed => experiment invalid
forbidden_until_execution_checkpoint: performance metric computation on real data
